_meta.confidence: mechanics reliable; numbers may be stale

battle_pass.description: Seasonal reward track, reached from the Daily Rewards / Great Value screen via the Battle Pass tab.
battle_pass.season_length: 28 days per pass. After the current pass ends, the next one becomes available.
battle_pass.progression: Complete Daily Tasks to earn activity points (XP). Each level on the pass unlocks rewards in each of the three tracks the player has access to.

exp_carryover.description: At the end of each season, EXP carries over to the next pass based on total EXP earned. Values below are the amount carried over.

battle_pass.post_cap_rewards: Once the pass reaches max level, every additional 50 activity points grants 1 Gray Key (used for Silver Chest pulls). Capped at 20 gray keys per season; activity points earned after that give no further reward for the season.
battle_pass.claim_all: A Claim All button at the bottom of the Battle Pass screen claims every unclaimed reward across the tracks the player has access to.
